scope: Fused build of the frozen native checkout with the selector TUI changes, and the instructions-entry persistence round trip in that built client. Source and loaded-storage evidence only; no GUI click, no service replacement, no deployment.

build.fileType: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64, dynamically linked, not stripped
build.previousBlocker: Retained 2026-10-29/30 runs were oom-killed near 960MiB peak with no artifact. The same frozen flag set completes on a quiet machine with about 2.5GiB available, so that failure was capacity pressure rather than a flag or source defect.

binarySmoke.command: built binary --version in an isolated HOME/XDG tree
binarySmoke.note: No shared service, config or state was touched; the isolated tree is /tmp/opencode/build-home.

selectorContent.interpretation: Selector strings are present in the built client, so the TUI half is no longer source-only.

persistenceRoundTrip.restart: service stop, then a fresh service pid (235551 -> 236056) answered the same GET with the identical entry
persistenceRoundTrip.interpretation: Write, service restart and read-back succeeded inside the built client. This is the storage/persistence half of the selector criterion, not the visible chooser, click, wheel cycling or per-chat navigation.

cleanup: Isolated service stopped; process scan finds zero processes for the built binary path.
limits: No GUI chooser, palette entry, wheel cycling or per-chat switching was observed.
No deployment or replacement of the user service, and no shared restart.
Peak memory was not instrumented; only completion and artifact identity are claimed.
The build used the frozen checkout with its existing dirty entries; no source was edited for this run.

isolationObserved.dataIsolated: The instruction entry exists only in the isolated database (instruction_entry row for the test session). The shared pilot database has no such session row.
isolationObserved.configNotIsolated: The built binary resolves its configuration from the pilot profile: debug config printed /home/james/.opencode-v2-pilot/config/opencode.jsonc even with HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at an empty tree. A plugin-loading experiment through an isolated config therefore cannot run this way.
isolationObserved.serviceStatusScope: Built-binary service status also reported the shared endpoint regardless of the isolated HOME, so restart claims must be scoped to the data directory actually used, not to the endpoint printed.
isolationObserved.sharedServiceUntouched: The shared service process (pid 6628, started 2026-11-01) was never stopped. The stop/start observed during the persistence test affected only the isolated instance that wrote the isolated database.
isolationObserved.strayServiceCleaned: A second service started by the later config probe (pid 276414) was stopped and a process scan now finds zero processes for that built binary serve command.
isolationObserved.limits: This is a point-in-time process check, not proof about every descendant or about other users.
